name: OTP for account creation
description: Replaces Drupal's registration email-verification link with a numeric one-time code the registrant types on a form.
project_description: OTP for account creation replaces Drupal core's link-based email verification at registration with a numeric one-time code. On install it sets user.settings:verify_mail to FALSE and alters the user register form so a new account is saved blocked, a random numeric code is generated and emailed, and the registrant is redirected to a verify form at /user/register/otp. Entering the correct code activates the account and logs the user in. The code length (1-10 digits, default 6), the email subject and body (with [user:otp] and [user:otp_form_url] tokens), and flood thresholds for generating and submitting codes are configurable at /admin/config/people/otp. No submodules, no services, no plugin types, no Drush commands, no permissions of its own; the settings route is gated by the core 'administer site configuration' permission and the verify/resend routes are open (_access: TRUE) because the user is not yet authenticated.
